item.title: ASCO 2026 Preview
item.description:
• Summary: ASCO 2026 is set to feature key readouts in head and neck cancer from Johnson & Johnson, Corbus Pharmaceuticals, Summit Therapeutics, Akero Therapeutics, and Bicara Therapeutics. Additionally, a wave of Chinese drugmakers is expected to present clinical data, highlighting the growing influence of China‑based biopharma in oncology. The preview underscores a diverse pipeline of novel mechanisms and global competitive dynamics.

  • Sources: Endpoints News, Endpoints News

item.title: Biotech Industry Strategy
item.description:
• Summary: A STAT analysis explores two key strategic priorities for the biotech industry: safeguarding domestic innovation from Chinese competition and the growing push toward longevity therapeutics. The article discusses policy measures to protect U.S. biotech while also highlighting significant investments in aging‑related R&D, reflecting a broadening of the sector's focus beyond traditional therapeutic areas.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: STAT News

item.title: FDA Commissioner Exit Campaign
item.description:
• Summary: An Endpoints News investigation reveals that a coordinated group of biotech companies ran a covert campaign to force out the FDA commissioner. The effort involved lobbying, media manipulation, and behind‑the‑scenes pressure. The story underscores the intense political and industry influence on the agency's leadership and the lengths some companies will go to shape regulatory direction.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Endpoints News

item.title: NIH Director Testimony
item.description:
• Summary: The National Institutes of Health (NIH) Director Jay Bhattacharya testified before a Senate committee regarding the agency's budget and research priorities. The hearing covered proposed funding cuts and their potential impact on biomedical research, including ongoing clinical trials and disease prevention programs. Bhattacharya defended the NIH's role in maintaining U.S. scientific leadership while facing questions on transparency and conflict-of-interest policies. The testimony sparked debate over the balance between fiscal constraints and the need for sustained investment in health research.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: STAT News, STAT News

item.title: Q1 Earnings Trends Podcast
item.description:
• Summary: This Pharmaceutical Technology podcast analyzes key themes emerging from Q1 earnings reports in the pharmaceutical industry. It covers supply chain disruptions, the growing dominance of obesity drugs (such as GLP-1 receptor agonists), and the impact of patent expirations.
